top_choice_rationale: Magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene closes a falsifiable theory-experiment loop: the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band prediction was followed by the 2018 discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, now reproduced by many independent groups and in other moire systems. A citation limited to the flat-band platform and observed phases avoids claiming the unsettled pairing mechanism. The credit exposure (Yuan Cao, the Dean group, earlier Lopes dos Santos-Peres-Castro Neto theory) and the eight-year age are real risks that I weigh but judge acceptable. P001 (optical lattice clocks) is a secure, cleanly attributed fallback I would support; P003 ranks third because of the Mele/Hasan/Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang allocation problem and overlap with the 2016 topology prize; no award is the least preferred since every proposal is prize-worthy.
